snippet.title: Presentiment of Death - Announcement Trailer | PS VR2 Games
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now 👉 https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015042

Classical music echoes. Time slows. The arrow flies.
Presentiment of Death is an upcoming cinematic VR action game where instinct, precision, and time itself shape every moment.

Wield your bow, manipulate time, and face relentless machines in a world on the edge of collapse.
This is not just survival.
This is your symphony of destruction.

Coming soon to PlayStation VR2.

#ps5 #psvr2 #psvr2games
